name: NASD2700
tagline: Xeon D-2700 NAS motherboard with 10GbE and IPMI
description: NASD2700 is a 244 x 258 mm extended micro-ATX motherboard, shown with Xeon D-2712T. Eight DDR4 ECC UDIMM slots, two 10GbE RJ45 and four 10GbE SFP+ ports, dedicated IPMI LAN, eight NVMe slots and up to twelve SATA connections support storage-system integration. ATX power, a compatible enclosure, cooling, memory and drives must be selected separately.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel Xeon D-2712T: 4 cores / 8 threads; 1.9 to 3.0 GHz; 65 W TDP

specs.label: CPU options
specs.value: D-2733NT / D-2752TER / D-2775TE / D-2796TE; 8 to 20 cores

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 8 x DDR4 ECC U-DIMM; 4 channels; D-2712T: 2667 MT/s, up to 1 TB with qualified DIMMs

specs.label: Expansion - PCIe
specs.value: 2 x physical x16 slots: one PCIe 4.0 x16, one PCIe 4.0 x8 signal

specs.label: Expansion - Cellular
specs.value: 2 x M.2 B-key slots for 4G / 5G modules; 2 x SIM slots

specs.label: BMC
specs.value: ASPEED AST2500; IPMI remote management; onboard status display

specs.label: Display
specs.value: VGA header provided by the BMC

specs.label: External I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0; 2 x 10GbE RJ45; 4 x SFP+; 1 x 1GbE IPMI

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: USB 3.0 socket, Type-E, USB 2.0, COM, GPIO, F_PANEL, SSI AUX

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.value: White PCB; 244 x 258 mm extended micro-ATX

specs.label: System
specs.value: Windows 10 / 11, Windows Server, Linux; UEFI boot only

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 8 x M.2 PCIe 3.0 x2: 6 x 2242 and 2 x 2242 / 2280; 3 x SFF-8643 via ASM1166; up to 12 x SATA 3.0; 1 x mSATA slot
